events.name: Vinyl Revival - Stark County's Vinyl Record Swap & Shop
events.description:
The Master Minds from The Auricle, Erie St. Vinyl, and Spinners & Sinners are back at it for our 8th Vinyl Revival Record Swap & Shop in Stark County!
Being avid lovers and collectors of vinyl records, we realized there is a void in the community for those looking to buy, sell, and trade their collections and wanted to rectify the situation, thus Vinyl Revival was born!
With over 15 Vendors, local collectors and enthusiasts can swap, shop and sell!
Listen to live DJ sets from Bors, Greg Weaver, DJ Matboy Slim, Austin Wolfe, & Miss Modular while grabbing a drink at the bar and trade stories with fellow collectors.
We're excited to be back with more vendors and more crates to loot!
Saturday, November 28th 2026
Vinyl Revival is from 10am-3pm
$5 Early "Crate Diggers" Admission 10am-11am
$2 General Admission from 11am-3pm
Cash & Credit accepted at the door
For More Information Please visit:
www.starkvinylrevival.com
VENDOR APPLICATIONS ARE NOT YET OPEN FOR THIS DATE
